# Git Submodule Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > Git

## Overview

Manages Git submodules and subtrees for multi-repository projects with proper initialization, updates, and workflow integration

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [git-submodule-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
git-submodule-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@git-submodule-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Add and configure Git submodules
- Update submodule references to specific commits
- Use subtrees as an alternative to submodules
- Handle nested submodule initialization

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Submodules**: Git submodule management and workflow
- **Subtrees**: Git subtree as submodule alternative
- **CI Integration**: Submodule handling in CI/CD
